summary.text: Michael Smith is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 41 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Smith earned a B.S. from Kennesaw State University and graduated from South Cobb High School.
He assumed office in the Georgia House on January 14, 2013, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Smith was assigned to the House Economic Development and Tourism Committee, the House Interstate Cooperation Committee, the Regulated Industries Committee, the State Properties Committee and the House Transportation Committee.
